findings.note: Listed as an author (with Wesco and Speedy) of HB 1334 Absentee voting. The committee version says an absentee ballot application must ask for certain identification numbers or a photocopy of the applicant's Indiana driver's license or ID card, and that the application may be delayed if the county cannot match at least one number to the voter's registration record.
subjects: ID number with a mail or absentee ballot application

findings.motion: HB 1264 Election security, House third reading, Roll Call 67 (passed 67 yea, 29 nay, 4 excused)
findings.note: Voted yea on House passage of HB 1264. As amended in the House (digest dated 2024-01-25), the bill sets proof-of-residency rules for in-person voter registration at registration agencies, and requires the state to compare the voter registration system with the BMV list of temporary credentials and follow a process when evidence exists that a registered voter is not a citizen.
subjects: proof of citizenship to stay registered
